title: Tools: make-pci-ids fixups.
description:
Add ID count sanity checks and make sure we don't update pci-ids.c
unless the checks pass. Fix a bunch of Pylint warnings. Strip leading
whitespace from our output strings.

(cherry picked from commit 85b99c18d936b2811be9ba9b27b89cc5246aeb66)

notes.body: enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for fbe8b36a43e1966b28cc326124d6461672767408 succeeds
